title: Delivered Status with Missing Delivery Timestamp
evidence: 8 orders marked as 'delivered' have a NULL order_delivered_customer_date. Accounts for 8 of 2,965 total missing delivery timestamps.
recommended_action: Do not compute lead times on these orders; investigate whether delivery confirmation was omitted.

title: Non-Delivered Orders with Null Delivery Dates
evidence: 2,957 orders across all non-delivered statuses naturally have NULL delivery dates (shipped=1,107, canceled=619, unavailable=609, invoiced=314, processing=301, created=5, approved=2). Fully reconciles all missing values: 8 delivered + 2,957 non-delivered = 2,965 total missing.
recommended_action: Filter order_status = 'delivered' before running logistics lead-time analyses.

title: Zero Value Payment Slices
recommended_action: Retain vouchers while auditing full voucher discount reconciliation.

title: Coordinates Outside Brazilian Geographic Bounding Box
evidence: 40 coordinate records fall outside continental Brazil coordinates.
recommended_action: Filter coordinates before spatial distance calculations or compute median centroid per zip prefix.

title: Product Category Translation Mapping Gaps
evidence: 610 products have NULL product_category_name. 13 products have non-null categories lacking an English translation across 2 distinct categories: 'portateis_cozinha_e_preparadores_de_alimentos' (10 products), 'pc_gamer' (3 products).
recommended_action: Do not invent placeholder categories or discard records. In Phase 2 DDL/reporting, leave English category as NULL or map 'pc_gamer' -> 'pc_gamer' and 'portateis_cozinha_e_preparadores_de_alimentos' -> 'portable_kitchen_food_preparers'.
